lessons.title: Lesson 1: Volunteer Work Vocabulary
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Volunteer Work Vocabulary.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.term: Past Simple and Past Continuous with When/While
concepts.definition: A long ongoing background action in the past (Past Continuous: was/were + V-ing) interrupted by a short, sudden action (Past Simple: V2/ed).
concepts.example: While we were cleaning the local park, it started to rain heavily.
concepts.essence: Past Continuous sets the movie scene; Past Simple triggers the sudden plot event.

concepts.definition: -ed adjectives describe a person's inner feeling or reaction. -ing adjectives describe the characteristic of the thing or person that causes the feeling.
concepts.example: The volunteer project was very interesting, so all students felt excited.
concepts.essence: -ing is the cause of feeling; -ed is the receiver of feeling.

rules.statement: While + Past Continuous, When + Past Simple
rules.meaning: 'While' introduces continuous duration; 'When' introduces punctual interruption.
rules.example: When the volunteer team arrived, the children were singing joyfully.

workedExamples.prompt: Choose the correct form: 'The children were (fascinating / fascinated) by the magic show at the charity center.'
steps: Step 1: The subject 'children' experiences the emotion of amazement.
Step 2: Describing human feeling requires the -ed ending: fascinated.

commonMistakes.mistake: Saying 'I am very boring' when you actually mean 'I feel bored'.
commonMistakes.why: 'I am boring' means you are a dull, uninteresting person; 'I am bored' means you feel lack of interest.
